description: Defines classes for iterating over DNS servers for different DNS transaction types, including general, DoH, and classic DNS, with mechanisms to handle server eligibility based on failure limits and attempt counts.

classes.name: DnsServerIterator
classes.description: Abstract base class for iterating over DNS servers, managing attempt counts and failure limits.

classes.name: DohDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class for iterating over DoH (DNS over HTTPS) servers with additional mode-based eligibility.

classes.name: ClassicDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class for iterating over classic DNS servers.

methods.name: GetNextAttemptIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the next server to attempt.

methods.name: AttemptAvailable
methods.description: Checks if there are servers available for attempt.

methods.name: DohDnsServerIterator
methods.description: Constructor for DoH server iterator with mode parameter.

methods.name: GetNextAttemptIndex
methods.description: Returns the next DoH server index.

methods.name: AttemptAvailable
methods.description: Checks if DoH servers are available for attempt.

methods.name: ClassicDnsServerIterator
methods.description: Constructor for classic DNS server iterator.

methods.name: GetNextAttemptIndex
methods.description: Returns the next classic DNS server index.

methods.name: AttemptAvailable
methods.description: Checks if classic DNS servers are available for attempt.
